definitions.explanation: A word or phrase that adds information to or limits the meaning of another word. Includes both adjectives (modifying nouns) and adverbs (modifying verbs).

examples.japanese: 「⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧」⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{修飾語|しゅうしょくご}だ。
{修飾語|しゅうしょくご}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{被修飾語|ひしゅうしょくご}→被修飾語：23643_hishuushokugo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: The modifier is placed before the word it modifies.

examples.japanese: ⟦{作文|さくぶん}→作文：02884_sakubun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{修飾語|しゅうしょくご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}い→使う：00473_tsukau⟧すぎる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{文|ぶん}→文：03716_bun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧わかりにくく⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If you overuse modifiers in writing, sentences become hard to understand.

notes:
A standard grammar term used in Japanese language education. Composed of ⟦{修飾|しゅうしょく}→修飾：00460_shuushoku⟧ (modification, embellishment) + ⟦{語|ご}→〜語：09841_go⟧ (word). In Japanese grammar education, modifiers are divided into two types.

TYPES OF MODIFIERS:
- {連体修飾語|れんたいしゅうしょくご}: adnominal modifier — modifies a noun (e.g., ⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧: red flower)
- {連用修飾語|れんようしゅうしょくご}: adverbial modifier — modifies a verb (e.g., ⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: walk slowly)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{被修飾語|ひしゅうしょくご}→被修飾語：23643_hishuushokugo⟧: the word being modified
- ⟦{修飾|しゅうしょく}→修飾：00460_shuushoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to modify
- ⟦{形容詞|けいようし}→形容詞：10419_keiyoushi⟧: adjective
- ⟦{副詞|ふくし}→副詞：00441_fukushi⟧: adverb
- {連体詞|れんたいし}: pre-noun adjectival (Japanese-specific category)

USAGE:
This term is learned in Japanese elementary school ⟦{国語|こくご}→国語：02739_kokugo⟧ (Japanese language) classes and continues through grammar study at all levels.
